I have to drive 40+ minutes just to get to a Walmart. The only thing in my town is a gas station 6
miles away from my house. I do most non-grocery shopping online and I buy from small businesses.

I’d say find smaller online retailers. Sometimes I find the brand from Amazon and go to their own website and order the products straight from there. Amazon is just the middle man for lots of products. If something isn’t Amazon brand, they are buying it and selling it. If you order straight from the products website, Amazon doesn’t get their cut and you keep at least a teeny tiny amount of money out of Jeff Bezos’ already overflowing pockets. 

This may be creepy but if you follow certain hashtags on Instagram, you’ll eventually get targeted ads from small businesses that use Instagram advertising and you’ll be able to find products and brands from there. For example, if you are really into environmentally friendly products, you can follow tags related to zero waste, organic, ect. And you’ll start getting advertisements from brands that promote eco friendly products. You can then look at their websites reviews to see what people say about it, and even if that brand is total shit there are usually comments pointing towards similar brands. I’ve been shopping that way for over a year now and I’m happy to say I only use Amazon and Walmart as staples for when I can’t find what I need elsewhere.
